name: Southeast New England Program (SNEP) Innovative Restoration Grants
summary: US federal grants for projects that restore coastal and river habitat in southeast New England, such as salt marshes, eelgrass, oyster reefs, floodplains and former cranberry bogs, while trying out new restoration methods or technologies.

geography.label: Southeast New England: coastal watersheds of Massachusetts and Rhode Island

reporting: Grantees must submit performance and financial reports as specified in the Notice of Award, including frequency, required forms, formatting, and submission method.

deadline.quote: December 11, 2026, 11:59 pm ET Application Submission Deadline

applicant_types.quote: This announcement requests full proposals from Indian Tribes, State & Local Governments, Institutions of Higher Education (IHEs), Interstate Agencies and Nonprofit organizations

geography.quote: EPA Region 1 anticipates awarding funds equitably among priorities and between Massachusetts and Rhode Island.

access.quote: Grants.gov creates a date and time record when it receives the application. If you submit the same application more than once, we will accept the last on-time submission.

window.quote: It is anticipated that up to 8 awards will be made under this announcement.

amount.quote: The amount of funding is expected to be $250,000 - $1,000,000, per award

co_finance_required.quote: Applicants must provide a non-federal cost share (match) equal to at least 15% of the federal funds requested.

reporting.quote: Reporting EPA's General Terms and Conditions in the Notice of Award will have information on performance and financial reports, including: • • • How often you will report. Any required form or formatting. How to submit them.
